term: finite population cover and accessible successor
definition: AccessibleSuccessor asserts a successor of the designated world. FinitePopulationCover supplies a finite list containing every rigid individual present at any accessible world. The individual type may be infinite. A finite hitting set is insufficient: it need not bound entire populations. FiniteCoverLaws quantifies these policies conditionally; FiniteCoverControls states alternating, infinite-tail and successor-free controls.
note: Mathematical semantics for #533. No metaphysical policy is defended. Existing rigid roster, presence, DeRe/DeDicto, contingency and joint absence retain their meanings.
